column1: # Commits that MUST be inside the next tester candidate, checked at bundle time by
# the container's scripts/build_tester_bundle.py: every commit listed here has to be
# an ancestor of the release artifact's source_sha, or the bundle is refused.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. v0.7.19's candidate was cut from a commit that predated the
# hidden-subtree fix in LayoutAudit. The fix was already on agent/integration. Nothing
# compared the two, and the whole layout-diagnostics category of that round came back
# void: 1,266 of 1,400 overflow records named a screen the tester never opened. The
# fact that the fix "must be in the next candidate" lived only in a tracker row a
# person had to remember to read.
# ADD a row when a fix has to ship in the next candidate and its absence would cost a
# round. DELETE the row once the commit is in main: it can no longer catch anything,
# and a file of permanently-satisfied lines is a file nobody reads.

column3: LayoutAudit walked hidden subtrees, so a candidate without this returns void layout evidence
Settings keybind column regressed to 300 on integration twice; a candidate without this ships an off-viewport Settings panel at menu scale 2
Prep printed the authored interaction_profiles as JSON over Begin Battle; without this any pack that authors a relationship cannot launch a map
